closed_scope: Nine exact native combat-control/dispatch/sync boundaries and selected inactive alternatives/particle/preview exclusions. No payload or owner is inferred from a codec or class name.

effects.actual_behavior: Clientbound visual-flag packet resolves entity ID and calls native proxy. ClientProxy applies flag87 only when that entity is exactly the local player, setting shared renderStaticScreenFor=60. Positive-counter Post GUI handler decrements only for alive player when gameTime differs from lastStaticTick. It stores current gameTime at the end of each positive-counter invocation, independent of whether camera-overlays layer draws. That layer renders static overlay with alpha=counter/60F. This is client-view obstruction, not server damage, blindness or entity rotation. Existing native producers are Farseer AttackGoal and GrizzlyBearAIAprilFools; those exact offensive/status packages remain independently pending.

effects.actual_behavior: Registered bidirectional handle enqueues work; nonnull context player/current level resolves part+parent IDs. When part implements IHurtableMultipart and parent LivingEntity, call onAttackedFromServer(parent,payload.damage,null), without native owner/distance or parent-link equality checks in this wrapper. Independently, nonempty damageType string resolves native DamageType registry/holder; only part==null and nonnull multipart parent admit parent.hurt(new ownerless DamageSource(holder),payload.damage), ignoring return. effects.actual_behavior: Clientbound Crow mount resolves original rider/mount, admits EntityCrow +Player mount and rider-to-mount distance<16D, then startRiding(force=true). Mosquito mount clientbound admits CrimsonMosquito, Enderiophage or BaldEagle with the same Player/distance gate. Crow dismount clientbound admits EntityCrow +any nonnull encoded mount then stopRiding. Registered bidirectional Mosquito dismount admits those three rider classes +nonnull encoded mount, then stopRiding; it does not check that encoded mount equals current vehicle. Inactive handleClient/handleServer alternatives are not additional registered callbacks. Native source IDs/attachment remain original; damage/control actor payloads are separate.
